title: 第2043章 你们真以为你们死不了第2042章 火刀 你确定
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
十五境的造物神王灰尘之地生物，姿态非常高，远比之前那些灰尘之地生物姿态更高。
阴虚看到这一幕，真想冲过去给这个十五境造物神王灰尘之地生物几个大嘴巴子。
装大蒙蔽了这群灰尘之地生物的双眼，这群灰尘之地生物完全看不到火刀和陈长生等所具有的威胁。
“没有办法了，只能破釜沉舟，强行动用未曾恢复的力量，以秘术离开这里！”
它在心里说道，真不看好野刻等一群装货！
不过——
动用未曾恢复的力量，也不是说动用就能直接动用的，它需要时间，而且等到事后，它会伤的更重，后面更难痊愈。
但它顾不得那么多。
要是现在不逃离这里，它都没有以后可讲，命都得丢在这里！
与此同时——
十五境造物神王灰尘之地生物，姿态依旧甚高。
它背负着双手，睥睨对面的火刀，没有任何出手的打算，让火刀先出手。
“好，既然你让我先出手，那我就出手了。”
火刀笑了一声，向前横斩一刀。
斩完这一刀后。
它说道：“我出完手了。”
“你在耍我？”
十五境造物神王灰尘之地生物，眸子中凶芒闪烁。
火刀出毛手了？
其所斩出的那一刀，一丁点的动静都没有，就是随便向前挥了一下，没有刀芒出现，也没有力量流出。

这哪里出手了，分明就是在戏耍它！
不过——
就在它声音落地间，它竟是突然感觉脖子发凉，且有血腥味飘出，它不可置信的向下看去。
血花喷洒。
火刀刚才竟真的没有戏耍它，真的出手了。
只不过斩出的那一刀，属于无形之刀。
它没有看到，更没有感应到，还以为火刀是在戏耍它！
“不！”
它发出最后的嘶吼声。
意识和生命气息等，全被瞬间彻底斩碎。
它的脑袋和身体分家，纷纷从高空中坠落下来，就此彻底毙命！
‘嘶’——
倒吸冷气的声音此起彼伏。
所有看到这一幕的生灵，全都倍感不可置信，如同见鬼般。
火刀简直不要太可怕了！
无声无息间，竟就将对面给斩首击杀掉了！
“吗的，我得赶紧离开这里！”
阴虚见到这一幕，瞳孔更是一阵缩动，加快速度，想要更快的离开这里。
然而——
它身旁的野刻，神色间竟还是非常的平静，没有丝毫的波澜。

“无形之刀吗？有点意思。”
野刻笑了一声，道：“不过，这依旧不算什么，不具有威胁。”
content_en:
The creation god king of the fifteenth realm, the creature from the land of dust, has a very high posture, far higher than the previous creatures from the land of dust.
When Yinxu saw this scene, he really wanted to rush over and give this fifteenth-level creation god king a creature from the land of dust a few big mouths.
Pretending to be big blinded the eyes of this group of dust land creatures. These dust land creatures were completely unable to see the threats posed by Huo Dao and Chen Changsheng.
"There is no other way but to break the boat, forcefully use the power that has not been recovered, and use secret techniques to leave here!"
It said in its heart, I really don’t like Ye Ke waiting for a group of cargo!
But——
Using the power that has not been recovered does not mean that it can be used directly. It takes time, and after the incident, it will be injured more seriously and it will be more difficult to recover later.
But it doesn't care about that much.
If it doesn't escape from here now, it will have no future and its life will be lost here!
At the same time——
The creature from the land of dust, the god king of creation in the fifteenth realm, still has a very tall posture.
It had its hands behind its back and stared at the fire knife across from it. It had no intention of taking action and let the fire knife strike first.
"Okay, since you asked me to take action first, then I will take action."
The fire knife laughed and slashed forward.
After finishing this cut.
It said: "I'm done."
"Are you kidding me?"
A creature from the land of dust, the god king of creation in the fifteenth realm, with a fierce light in his eyes.
Is the Fire Knife at fault?
The sword he slashed out didn't make any movement at all. Even if he swung it forward casually, no sword light appeared and no power flowed out.
What's going on here? You're clearly playing with it!
But——
Just as its voice fell to the ground, it suddenly felt a chill on its neck, and the smell of blood wafted out. It looked down in disbelief.
Blood sprays.
Huo Dao actually didn't play with it just now, he really took action.
It's just that the sword that was struck was an invisible sword.
It didn't see it, let alone sense it, and thought the fire knife was playing tricks on it!
"No!"
It roared one last time.
Consciousness, life breath, etc. were all completely chopped into pieces in an instant.
Its head and body separated and fell from the sky one after another, completely killing it!
‘His’——
The sounds of gasps came one after another.
All the creatures who saw this scene were in disbelief, as if they had seen a ghost.
The fire knife is simply too scary!
Without a sound, he decapitated the opponent!
"Oh no, I have to get out of here quickly!"
When Yinxu saw this scene, his pupils shrank even more, and he sped up, wanting to leave here faster.
However——
The expression of Ye Ke beside it was still very calm, without the slightest disturbance.
"Invisible knife? It's interesting."
Ye Ke laughed and said: "However, this is still nothing, it is not a threat."
